Hi Sara  nice to meet you over email. Below is a concise, shareable confirmation you can pass to Legal/Security. Happy to hop on a call if you need more detail.

---
Redwood PII handling confirmation (prompts & outputs)  summary for Acme Health

1) What is stored
- Prompts and outputs: By default, Redwood may persist prompts and model outputs for a limited retention window to support observability, billing, and incident investigation.
- Logs & traces: We capture metadata for requests (timestamps, model id, token counts, request latency) for operational monitoring. Request/response payloads may be included in traces if request-level logging is enabled.
- Derived data: We do not use customer prompt/outputs to improve public models or for model training without explicit contractual agreement.

2) Where data is stored (residency)
- For your pilot we can enable US-only residency: data will be stored in our US region (primary: us-west-2).
- For Dedicated/Private deployments, data remains in customer-controlled VPCs or on-prem as configured.

3) Retention periods
- Default (hosted): prompt/output payloads retained for 30 days by default.
- Audit logs & billing metadata: retained for 365 days.
- Custom retention: We can support shorter retention (7/14/30 days) via configuration for pilot customers under a DPA addendum.

4) Logging controls and disabling storage
- Route-level control: We support per-route flags to disable request/response persistence. If you enable the "no-persist" route setting, payloads for that route are not written to persistent storage (still counted for billing unless you use a separate metering config).
- Sampling: We offer sampling controls for traces so you can limit captured payloads.
- Redaction: Fields can be redacted at the SDK/proxy layer before hitting our API.

5) Security & compliance notes
- SOC 2 Type II summary attached (Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf).
- We support KMS-backed encryption for Dedicated/Private keys and customer-managed KMS for Private deployments.

6) Next steps
- If Acme requires a shorter retention or a route-level no-persist guarantee, we can add that to the pilot SOW and DPA.
- I can provide a short configuration guide for setting up US-only residency + route flags.

---
